title: Fourth power of the order-two Gowers norm
statement: For a function $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, the fourth power of its order-two Gowers norm equals the sum of the fourth powers of all its Fourier coefficients: $\|f\|_{U^2}^4=\sum_{\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n}\widehat f(\gamma)^4$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
